result:
I shipped nothing this run. Two earlier runs already did the work on the end cards and confirm dialogs (v34.32 and v34.33), and no card reached a critic score of 4. All four (35, 38, 59, 60) sit at 3.

The remaining critic findings are either contradictory between cards or ask for new elements (a danger tab, a pad glyph, a fifth stat cell), which this task forbids. The card-size dock is on purpose: the style guide treats an end card and a confirm as dialogs (his Q43 and Q54).

One untried idea is left in my notes: set stat values to 24px and block gaps to 32px on all four cards. It might lift one card to 4, but it changes shared css that other cards use, so I held back.

TASK PARTIAL: no card has reached critic 4; the stat 24px and block gap 32px follow-up is untried.
